messages:
sana: quick alert 1:30 UTC eu-west mTLS handshakes between svc-x -> svc-y intermittently failing, some pods OK, some not. small error rate but reproducible.

omar: grabbing proxy logs; seeing KMS decrypt denies during client cert unwrap on the failing pods.

tera: i think a policy prune merged last night removed svc-x signer from the CMK. deploy-bot shows PR merged by omar. cc @omar

deploy-bot: deploy: "rbac/prune-cmk-principals" merged by omar at 2026-03-24T01:12:08Z.

omar: that's me. rolling back now and will add a canary.

sana: immediate: rollback + restart signer agents on affected nodes; follow-up: require sec review for PRs touching KMS key policies, and add an alert for KMS Decrypt/Verify denies >0/min per region.

sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-050 created: KMS deny spike eu-west; ticket link internal.

omar: rollback applied, canaries green in ~90s. will open follow-up PR for gating + CI canary.
